name: Charm of Power raises Gravity Bomb's explosion damage by 50% (#1237)
contract: Charm of Power 706100 carries SPELL_AURA_ADD_PCT_MODIFIER (108) with EffectMiscValue SPELLMOD_DAMAGE (0) and EffectSpellClassMask word0 bit 0x10000; EffectBasePoints 49 resolves to 50 with DieSides 1, matching the tooltip "Increases the damage dealt by Gravity Bomb by $s1%." The only family-28 record with SpellFamilyFlags word0 bit 0x10000 is 801282 "Gravity Bomb", the SPELL_EFFECT_SCHOOL_DAMAGE explosion that the Gravity Bomb debuff's periodic trigger casts; its AttributesEx3 is 0x40000000 (DO_NOT_DISPLAY_RANGE), not IGNORE_CASTER_MODIFIERS. Native path only: AuraEffect::CalculateSpellMod, SpellInfo::IsAffectedBySpellMod, and Unit::SpellDamageBonusDone, which applies SPELLMOD_DAMAGE last to the finished damage. The Chronomancer stays the caster of 801282 because its EffectImplicitTargetA 53 makes it need an explicit unit target, so AuraEffect::HandlePeriodicTriggerSpellAuraTick routes the cast through the debuff's caster.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Gravity Bomb's explosion damage is unmodified without the talent
Gravity Bomb's explosion damage is 50% higher with the talent
